$comment: OPS-6 — advisories that scripts/audit-deps.mjs should not fail on.
An entry here is an accepted risk with a named reason, not a mute button.
Every entry must say why the advisory is not reachable in what we ship, and
carry a reviewBy date so 'accepted' cannot quietly become 'forgotten'.
If you cannot write a reachability argument, do not add the entry — upgrade
the dependency instead. That is what happened to the hono advisories found
on 2026-08-11: they were unreachable AND patched, so they were fixed rather

accepted.reason: Not in any shipped bundle. toml@3.0.0 comes only from @effect/cli, which @livestore/utils imports solely in its Node entry (@livestore/utils/node); the SPA and the Workers import @livestore/utils/effect and never load it. It sits in node_modules as a livestore peer dependency.
